visual_overrides.core_identity: A large ground-hunting wolf spider adapted for ambush rather than web-building, with a stockier body and prominent forward-facing eyes.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Low muscular spider body with sturdy eight-leg spread, compact abdomen, and flattened stalking posture.
visual_overrides.head_features: Broad arachnid cephalothorax with several eyes including a prominent forward-facing pair and short powerful fangs.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Stockier than a web-building spider, with thick jointed legs and a compact abdomen built for sudden movement.
visual_overrides.surface: Sparse coarse hair tufts on legs and body without becoming a furry mammal.

scene_overrides.natural_posture: Flattened against floor, wall, or ceiling with multiple legs visibly supporting the body; no mammal-like crouch.
behavior_style: stalking low without a capture web
waiting flattened against stone above or beside a route
